independent_checks.reason: Oppositely oriented reflected disk with unchanged heights/over-under realizes the reversed-orientation second ball; identity product collars glue each actual pj to barpj with no extra crossings or permutation. Thus crossing count is exactly2n.

Using the same given h on both copies agrees on the identity-glued entire boundary, descends to a doubled pair homeomorphism, and transports the same endpoint permutation on both sides. The reversed-copy component orientation convention is compatible with an oriented h.
The explicit NE/SW versus NW/SE resolutions interchange under E-W reflection with over-under unchanged. Thus the global states are A(D) joined to reflected B(D), and conversely.

The only planar pairings are P=(12)(34) and Q=(14)(23). Tracing each table row with actual j-to-j gluing yields two circles for equal pairings and the stated single four-arc walk for unequal pairings. Closed relative circles are never touched by this gluing.

Across a crossing-to-crossing edge, outward left-color and over-under bits BOTH reverse; A-turning color therefore propagates within that shadow component. Different components need not have the same phase. Each actual state component follows one actual global region; no uniqueness of state circle per region is assumed.

If opposite same-color sectors belong to one region, an embedded complementary path closed through the crossing supplies the forbidden interior nugatory circle. If distinct opposite regions both meet the sole boundary circle, their disjoint region-to-boundary arcs joined through the crossing supply the exact Definition2.2 forbidden proper arc. Hence opposite turning regions are distinct and at least one is interior, in EACH color.

Distinct turning regions force distinct relative state components. An interior turning region cannot support a boundary-ended state component, since every port collar is incident to boundary intervals. Thus one component at every resolution of every crossing is a closed circle wholly within that half.

The closed witness in the relevant original A or B relative state cannot merge under the four port identifications. This proves distinct global state circles at all crossings in BOTH halves for BOTH global states, exactly the two one-sided conditions in the checked1988 definition.
